_comment: PRL Tidio->Zapier->SugarCRM UAT fixtures. Sandbox lead ids below are PLACEHOLDERS — not real Sugar records. Rules are REUSED, not invented — see prl_uat_harness.py header for per-field provenance (task7-state-parser.test.js for state/name parsing, 2026-08-18-dod-reconciliation.md for lead_source/dedup/enrichment gates, prl-system-ssot.md for the pipeline shape, the 1.2A acceptance-tests doc for account_name/duplicate/Note checks, STATE-OF-SUGAR-2026-08-11.md + INTEGRATION-DOSSIER.md for the real Sugar Leads schema: the 6 required fields account_name/first_name/last_name/phone_work/lead_source/location_c, and email written to email1 not a Sugar 'email' column). NOTE on a real doc conflict, resolved here in favor of the later/verified source: INTEGRATION-DOSSIER.md (2026-08-11) says location_c is written as a FULL state name; 2026-08-18-dod-reconciliation.md explicitly DISPROVES that ('the full-name claim was a sampling artifact') and the 1.2A acceptance-tests doc (also 2026-08-18) says location_c is 'a real fallback state code' — consistent with task7-state-parser.test.js's abbreviation output and prl-system-ssot.md's verified real run ('location_c=CT'). This harness follows the later, verified, abbreviation contract.

fixtures.label: clean-lead-web-form
fixtures.notes: Baseline happy path: simple two-token name, full state name resolves cleanly (task7 'full name' case: California -> CA), short company name, single submission.

fixtures.label: title-suffix-name-chatbot
fixtures.notes: Name split is first-space-only, per task7-state-parser.test.js parseName contract: 'Dr. Jane Smith Jr.' -> first_name='Dr.', last_name='Jane Smith Jr.' (title/suffix stays attached to whichever side the split lands it on, not guessed away). State input uses punctuation-stripping (task7 'punctuated N.Y.' case: 'N.Y.' -> NY, not failed). Chatbot leg carries a transcript Note and is resubmitted once (dedup check) with email present, per the DoD-reconciliation open defect that dedup search is UNSAFE only when email is empty — this fixture keeps email populated so dedup should collapse to one lead, not corrupt an arbitrary record.

input.transcript_or_blurb: Chat transcript: visitor asked about pricing tiers, requested a callback re: enterprise plan.

fixtures.label: long-company-unparseable-state-web-form
fixtures.notes: Long free-text company name must not be silently truncated (Fix 3, chatbot leg deferred as low-risk there; re-checked here for web forms per the 1.2A acceptance-tests doc). State input is non-US free text -- task7's 'Toronto' case: parser falls back to state_code='CA' but sets state_parse_failed=true. Per the DoD-reconciliation's own correction of the stale plan ('silent CA-lead (parse fallback; audit-trailed)') the fallback to CA is EXPECTED and not itself a defect -- the defect class is a fallback that is NOT flagged. So this fixture's PASS bar is: location_c=='CA' AND state_parse_failed==true (never state_parse_failed==false on a fallback, which would mean the wrong code slipped through silently as if it were a real parse).
